If no positive lesson survives the evidence, record a concrete negative result and what later workers should avoid or test. The candidate is incomplete until both files are updated. Work only inside this Phase 2 workspace.

is provided. Base controller proposals only on the task contract, current and
inherited guidance, sampled solver results, inherited optimizer logs, and
current rollout evidence. Do not search for or reconstruct the omitted shelf
from neighboring configurations or repository history.

I’m starting with the workspace contract and the wake-visual inspection skill, then I’ll trace the current rollout and inherited evidence before changing the single solver candidate. I’ll keep all work inside this Phase 2 workspace and won’t use external or neighboring-repository material.

The inherited bank shows a clear current anchor: opposing-posterior headroom at `0.50` reached `2.13L` but still curled upward and saturated. I’m now reading the four sampled rollouts and parent optimizer traces to separate duplicate successes from the near/failure cases, then I’ll inspect their keyframe sheets before writing any candidate reasoning.

The visual/metric cross-check is decisive: all four sampled successes are semantically identical and reproduce the same `88.13`-unit diagonal capture bit-for-bit, while the inherited close-gated failure remains above the target and exits upward at `2.21L`. The successful route is actively propelled and lowers crossflow/load, but it still takes a pronounced lower-side excursion and hits the posterior angle plus both rate/command caps. I’m narrowing the candidate to one conservative, falsifiable refinement of that proven route.

The candidate hypothesis is now recorded before the solver edit, as required by the visual-first skill. I’m keeping the proven navigation controller intact and testing only a modest `1650 → 1550 deg/time²` policy-owned command ceiling; this isolates actuator economy without reopening the closed steering/gain axes.

The solver and durable guidance are updated. Per the workspace contract, I’m invoking the prescribed check-runner now; it will validate the policy/schema and parent-guidance delta without running CFD.
